verbatim_quote.original: حله، اگه اوکیه منم قبول دارم، ببند. تسک رو ببندیم، بعد که بستی گلوبال سینک رو انجام بده، به من بگو ریستارت رو انجام بدم که بریم ریپوی دیسیژن رو بسازیم و همین دیسیژن‌هایی که داخل همین ریپو هستن رو مایگریشن کنیم توی چیز جدیدمون. و از اینجا پاکش کنیم.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: OK, if it's fine I accept too — close it. Let's close the task; after closing, do the global sync, tell me to restart so we build the decision repo, migrate this repo's decisions into our new thing, and delete them from here.

extracted_decision.summary: Closure chain: close META 219, run global install upgrade, restart, create the personal decisions repo, migrate local records into it, prune them locally. Commit+push stay Manager-owned at restart under ZAC.
extracted_decision.rationale: Manager sequences closure → upgrade → fresh-repo standup → migration → prune so nothing is lost.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Restart in the middle; commit tooling had to be driven over MCP stdio.
